summary: Show the person's existing ordered Pins and editable row pin actions in the web sidebar

replay.detail: Existing arrangement membership claims are reused.

rules.detail: Existing membership lifecycle and ordering rules apply.

compatibility.detail: Pins edits require granted control and a synced follow. Creating a version-2 Pins arrangement remains disabled by default.

manual.detail: No arrangement is automatically created or migrated.

recovery.detail: Reverting the UI preserves stored memberships and Sidebar folders.
